result.query: SELECT CASE WHEN vpc_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'vpc' WHEN subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'subnet' WHEN eip_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'eip' WHEN snat_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'snat' ELSE 'lb' END AS kind,count(*),round(max(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()-next_run_at))) AS max_due_seconds FROM network_reconciliations WHERE next_run_at<clock_timestamp() AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<clock_timestamp()) GROUP BY 1;
